items.claim: `samples` unbounded, and `NaN` throws, on the spline bases, plus `arcSamples` unbounded on the puzzle base
items.note: Spline `samples` is held to 48..1024 and `arcSamples` to 6..256; `NaN` reads as the least. `MAX_SAMPLES` moved into `polygonSampler.ts`. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A spline base's `count: NaN` or `count: undefined` throws
items.note: `NaN` now reads as the least (3 anchors), per round 57's ruling on counts. The `undefined` case is fixed by 28b4c1cfbc.

items.claim: octant-spline anchors that share an `s` blow the curve up
items.note: Anchors within 1e-6 of one `s` become one point. At s = 0 the first of them is kept, elsewhere the last, so the end anchor that quadrant mode pins survives. octant-bspline keeps them all. This was my call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: octant-bspline steps at each cardinal in quadrant mode
items.note: The knot vector is now uniform, and in quadrant mode the phantom points wrap from the far end, so the curve repeats with period 1. `octantBSplineRadius` takes an optional `mode` (a minor changeset), and ui-lab's spline editor passes it. Every octant-bspline outline changes slightly, and the test's pinned B-spline values were regenerated.

items.claim: octant-bspline has a corner at s = 0 and s = 1 in octant mode
items.note: the same change. The uniform knots make the mirrored phantom points exactly symmetric; a test checks that r(−e) = r(e) and r(1+e) = r(1−e).

items.claim: A param set to `undefined` replaces the default, giving `NaN` geometry, a ribbon end that throws, and a puzzle edge drawn as a socket
items.note: Every base and `resolveCompose` now merge through `withDefaults`. An end or edge name a base doesn't know now throws a `RangeError` naming it; that was my call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

Bounded params go through `clampParam`; `rotation` and powerline `depth`, which have no bounds, go through a new `finiteOr`, so an infinite value also reads as the default. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Puzzle sockets cross each other within the allowed `tabSize`
items.note: `tabSize` now stops where two sockets would touch: about 30.9 with two opposite sockets and 24.6 with two adjacent ones. A test checks every combination of edges at 40 and finds no crossing outline. This was my call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A pinched rounded-rect reports the unpinched `totalCss` and walks by unpinched arc length
items.note: It now measures the squeezed outline itself and walks it by that length. A's sub-point about square corners being cut is fixed in the same commit: the drawn path now has a vertex at every corner.

items.claim: octant-bspline badge dents at its cardinal and diagonal points
items.note: The old expected end values in `octantSplines.test.ts` were wrong and are replaced. `fittedOutline.test.ts`'s "pads further where it crosses one onto the content" depended on that dent, so it now uses a quatrefoil with `valleyR: 10`: 4af5a4ee70.

items.claim: powerline's side-edge segments get the bottom normal, and every edge point gets a sideways one whatever its slope
items.note: Normals now come from `polygonSampler`, built from each edge's own direction.

items.claim: rounded-rect at `erosion: 0, pinch: 1` returns a zero normal along its collapsed ends
items.note: The outline's own normal is used where the pinched tangent vanishes.

items.claim: ribbon with both ends tapered crosses itself on a narrow badge
items.note: The taper is held to `boxW / 2`, like the chamfered-rect's chamfer.

items.claim: quatrefoil's smoothMax lifts its tips past `spikeR` and `lobeR`
items.note: It is now a polynomial smooth max, exact outside a band narrow enough to leave both tips alone; the valley lift at the defaults is still 1.5.

items.claim: `resolveEdge` resolves prototype names like `'toString'` to Object.prototype functions
`PerimeterPoint`'s normal is documented in viewBox units but returned in CSS px
items.note: (doc only, no changeset because the type isn't exported).

items.claim: puzzle `tabSize` is documented as 0..50 but clamped to 2..40
